title: STREAM: Social data and knowledge collective intelligence platform for TRaining Ethical AI Models
benchmark_measurement: Collection of religious belief as a demographic variable for analyzing and aligning AI models with the moral judgments of specific human populations.
findings: The paper presents no specific findings related to religion. It notes that religious belief is collected as a demographic variable from human subjects, which allows for potential future analysis of how moral judgments vary across different religious groups, but no such analysis was conducted or presented in this work.
